title: coffee.state
description: One coffee, whole, as the catalogue last saw it. Carried in full so that no consumer has to call the producer back.

product_kind.description: What the product is, from the agreed vocabulary. Absent or null means the producer has not decided: that is not beans, and a consumer must not read an undecided product as coffee. other means the producer has decided and the product is none of the named kinds: a decided answer, not a missing one. The list is frozen for this wire version; other is the escape for a kind not yet named, and promoting one to a named kind is a new wire version.

product_kind_source.description: How product_kind was decided, as a sentence. Free text on purpose: it records a method, not a vocabulary.

arabica_pct.description: Share of arabica the shop states, in percent. Null means the shop stated nothing, which is not the same as 0.

robusta_pct.description: Share of robusta the shop states, in percent. Null means the shop stated nothing, which is not the same as 0.

delisted_at.description: Set once the shop stopped listing it. A delisting is a state rather than a deleted message, so it survives the stream's per-subject compaction.
